settings.title: Delivery Guide & Package Inspection
settings.content:
Upon delivery, it is necessary to check package counts, ensure the outer carton and security tape are intact and unaltered, and sign courier receipt.

Any discrepancy or damage must be contested immediately in writing specifying that acceptance is made 'with reservation'.

settings.title: Shipping Costs and Delivery Times
settings.desc: Orders placed Monday to Friday before 2:00 PM CET with Express Shipping are entrusted to our courier on the same business day.
settings.footer_note: * Delivery times may vary during sales and holiday periods.

settings.title: Shipment Monitoring & Tracking
settings.content: You will receive a shipment confirmation email containing the courier tracking code as soon as your parcel leaves our logistics warehouse. The tracking activates within 24 hours.

settings.title: Sending a Gift & Luxury Packaging
settings.content: Select the luxury gift package option at checkout (+ € 8,00) to receive an exclusive black & white Liu Jo presentation box with a personalized printed greeting card.

settings.panel_subheading: Everything you need to know regarding placing orders, dispatch timelines, and worldwide shipping.
